result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but there are several visual/consistency defects: the active 'Pizza' filter doesn't match the displayed content, truncated text in the horizontal carousel, inconsistent favorite-icon styling, and content clipped at the viewport edges.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as active/selected, yet the listings below are poké, burgers, pasta and ramen — the filter appears not to be applied to the results.
issues.suggestion: Either filter the result lists to pizza places when the chip is active, or reset the chip to 'All' so the selected state matches the content shown.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its delivery price are hard-cut at the right screen edge with no ellipsis or visual affordance, making the text look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek so partially visible cards show a consistent sliver, and truncate titles with an ellipsis instead of clipping mid-glyph.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent heart button treatment across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge showing only a thin sliver of the next chip, giving the impression of a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent list padding and a fade/peek so the next chip is partially visible in a deliberate way.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no name, rating or metadata visible, so it reads as an incomplete card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so cards scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell, favorite hearts) have no visible text label; if accessible labels are also missing, screen-reader users cannot identify them.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each icon button has an accessible label such as 'Notifications' or 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites'.
